note: Observations from the planning reconnaissance (HEAD 24067f5). The static stage adds them as candidates with origin=recon AFTER the finders ran, so finders stay independent. They go through the same single refuter and judge. Line numbers are hints; refuters re-read the current code. The missing socket-length check in e2e/control.js was fixed while building this infrastructure and is not listed.

findings.title: rename_asset_file is a #[tauri::command] that is not registered in generate_handler!
findings.trigger: Any build; the command cannot be invoked from the frontend.
findings.mechanism: The function carries #[tauri::command] but lib.rs generate_handler! does not list it, so it is dead code with a live-looking IPC surface.
findings.impact: Dead code that reviewers may assume is reachable; drift between the IPC contract doc and the handler list.

findings.title: clear_all_thumbnails is registered but has no UI entry point
findings.trigger: Any session; no frontend wrapper or control calls the command.
findings.mechanism: The command is in generate_handler! but no src/platform/tauri wrapper or settings action uses it.
findings.impact: An exposed IPC endpoint without a caller widens the surface and is untested from the UI.

findings.title: ThumbnailImage fadeIn prop has no production users
findings.trigger: Any render; no production component passes fadeIn.
findings.mechanism: The gallery fade was removed in the grid-performance refactor, but the prop and CSS classes remain.
findings.impact: Dead code path and CSS that tests may still exercise as if live.

findings.title: CSV export creates the target directory before validating the destination
findings.trigger: Export CSV to a path whose parent does not exist, including a path that later fails validation.
findings.mechanism: fs::create_dir_all(parent) runs before the root checks, then a .tmp file is written next to the target.
findings.impact: Directories may be created at a rejected location; an export may leave a .tmp file on failure.

findings.title: Backup export creates the target directory before validating the destination
findings.trigger: Export a backup to a path whose parent does not exist, including a path that later fails validation.
findings.mechanism: fs::create_dir_all(parent) runs before the destination checks, then a .tmp file is written next to the target.
findings.impact: Directories may be created at a rejected location; a failed export may leave a .tmp file.

findings.title: Lightbox delete shows window.alert without checking the dispose guard
findings.trigger: Delete an asset whose source is missing or whose cleanup is pending, then close the lightbox before the delete resolves.
findings.mechanism: window.alert runs for source_status missing/cleanup_pending before the `!disposed && generation === request` check that guards setConfirm.
findings.impact: A blocking alert can appear after the lightbox was closed or another asset was selected.

findings.title: Maintenance gate and library-wide locks wait without a timeout
findings.trigger: A backup export/import holds the maintenance gate, or Clear library / Remove root waits for with_scan_and_thumb_lock while a long scan or thumbnail render runs.
findings.mechanism: admit() and maintenance() loop on Condvar::wait without a deadline; with_scan_and_thumb_lock blocks without a limit as well.
findings.impact: Every new DB operation stalls for the whole maintenance window; a stuck holder hangs the app with no error.

findings.title: app:control doctor accepts an empty scan-root list
findings.trigger: Clear library or remove the only root, then add a root through the native picker.
findings.mechanism: doctor only rejects roots different from manifest.media; an empty list passes, so the check proves nothing until a root exists again.
findings.impact: The root guard does not fire between Clear library and the next add; a wrong folder chosen in the picker is caught only by the next doctor.

findings.title: testing.md says grid_baseline has three ignored diagnostics; the file has four
findings.trigger: Reading the doc to run the baseline diagnostics.
findings.mechanism: src-tauri/tests/grid_baseline.rs has four #[ignore] tests; the doc says three.
findings.impact: Doc/code drift; a diagnostic may be missed when results are compared.
